title: Meta Launches Muse AI Assistant App For IPad
key_facts: Meta announced on Wednesday (7 Oct 2026) that its Muse AI assistant is now a dedicated iPad app, about a month after its 8 Sep launch on iOS and Android.
Muse has topped 6.6 million installs since 8 Sep, according to Sensor Tower estimates.
Muse lets users connect accounts to handle email, meetings, bills, and tasks such as booking reservations, ordering groceries and making purchases.
New 'connectors' include small-business tools (Asana, Canva, Dropbox, Figma, QuickBooks, GitHub, Klaviyo, Zoom, Meta ad accounts) plus Notion and Granola.
Retail partners Best Buy, Gap, Sephora, Walmart and Wayfair let the agent shop and complete purchases on users' behalf.
Websites can mistake agents for bots and block them; on Tuesday (6 Oct) Meta said it is working with partners on an open standard letting personal AI agents identify themselves to businesses.
quote_evidence: The company on Wednesday announced that its Muse assistant is now available in a dedicated iPad app.
Since launching on iOS and Android on September 8, Muse has topped 6.6 million installs, according to estimates from market intelligence firm Sensor Tower.
why_it_matters_hint: Muse is Meta's consumer AI agent that can act on a user's behalf in other services.
notes: The Dataconomy page is a near-verbatim copy of TechCrunch's text, so TechCrunch is credited. Event on 7 Oct, before the window, so lowered by 1.
